Model Number: A82E2
Anker USB-C to USB-C Cable (240W, Upcycled-Braided)
Super Durable. Ultra-Soft. Eco-Friendly.
 
Fast. Colorful. Sustainable. Choose sustainability without sacrificing speed—this high-speed cable comes in 5 vibrant finishes, offering fast 480 Mbps data transfer and exceptional durability thanks to its soft PCR braided construction. (Note: This cable does not support screen mirroring.)
 
Unwrap to Smooth Charging
Comes with a silicone cable organizer, making it easy to wrap, store, and use without any tangles or frustration.
 
Green and Clean
Our sustainable cable comes in completely plastic-free packaging, uses recycled nylon for the cable, and employs natural materials and inks for the packaging, ensuring a minimal carbon footprint.
 
Wide Compatibility
Whether it's your USB-C phone, tablet, or laptop, experience high performance charging every time.
